name: design-intelligence
description: Turns a Figma screen into a compliant MUI implementation (or a Figma screen) and reviews it against your organization's design system. Bundles six skills (Figma analysis, Figma-to-code adapter, design-system generation, Figma screen generation, design-system review, and skill maintenance), a steward agent, and shared design-system knowledge and configuration, with your org's values kept in a local, git-ignored overlay.
